elements.requirement: A person is guilty of burglary if that person enters any building or part of a building as a trespasser and with intent to commit an offence of stealing anything in the building or part of a building in question, inflicting grievous bodily harm on any person therein, or doing unlawful damage to the building or anything therein.
elements.quote: enters any building or part of a building as a trespasser and with intent to commit any such offence as is mentioned in subsection (2) below

elements.requirement: A person is guilty of burglary if, having entered any building or part of a building as a trespasser, that person steals or attempts to steal anything in the building or that part of it, or inflicts or attempts to inflict on any person therein any grievous bodily harm.
elements.quote: having entered any building or part of a building as a trespasser he steals or attempts to steal anything in the building or that part of it or inflicts or attempts to inflict on any person therein any grievous bodily harm

elements.requirement: The offences referred to under the intent requirement include offences of stealing anything in the building or part of a building in question, inflicting grievous bodily harm on any person therein, and doing unlawful damage to the building or anything therein.
elements.quote: The offences referred to in subsection (1)(a) above are offences of stealing anything in the building or part of a building in question, of inflicting on any person therein any grievous bodily harm ... therein, and of doing unlawful damage to the building or anything therein.

elements.requirement: A person guilty of burglary shall on conviction on indictment be liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding fourteen years where the offence was committed in respect of a building or part of a building which is a dwelling.
elements.quote: where the offence was committed in respect of a building or part of a building which is a dwelling, fourteen years

elements.requirement: A person guilty of burglary shall on conviction on indictment be liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding ten years in any case other than where the offence was committed in respect of a building or part of a building which is a dwelling.
elements.quote: in any other case, ten years

elements.requirement: Statutory references to a building, and the reference to a building which is a dwelling, apply also to an inhabited vehicle or vessel.
elements.quote: shall apply also to an inhabited vehicle or vessel

elements.requirement: Statutory provisions regarding an inhabited vehicle or vessel apply to any such vehicle or vessel both at times when the person having a habitation in it is not there and at times when that person is there.
elements.quote: shall apply to any such vehicle or vessel at times when the person having a habitation in it is not there as well as at times when he is

thresholds.what: maximum term of imprisonment on conviction on indictment where the burglary was committed in respect of a building or part of a building which is a dwelling
thresholds.quote: where the offence was committed in respect of a building or part of a building which is a dwelling, fourteen years

thresholds.what: maximum term of imprisonment on conviction on indictment for burglary in any case not involving a dwelling
thresholds.quote: in any other case, ten years
